name: ru.paydadosh/dictionary
title: PaydaDosh — Ingush dictionary
description: Ingush–Russian dictionary: lookup, paradigms, corpus, draft translation, numbers, text checks

tools.name: search_dictionary
tools.description: Look up a word in PaydaDosh, the Ingush–Russian dictionary (headwords merged from dozens of printed dictionaries). Works both ways: Ingush → Russian («дог», «кӀант», «гӀалгӀай») and Russian → Ingush («сердце», «закрыть», «спасибо»; inflected Russian forms are reduced to the dictionary form). Palochka may be typed as I, 1, l or |. Returns headwords with part of speech, Russian definition, the codes of the printed sources and a link to the word page; for Russian queries also entries of Ozdoev's Russian–Ingush dictionary (ОЗД80). If the query is an inflected Ingush form, `wordform_of` names its lemma — call analyze_word for the full analysis. found=false means the dictionary has no such word: say so, do not invent one.

query.description: Ingush or Russian word or short phrase, e.g. «дог», «кӀант», «гӀалгӀай», «сердце», «закрыть».
query.title: Query

direction.description: auto (default) detects the language; ing_to_rus — the query is Ingush; rus_to_ing — Russian.
direction.title: Direction

tools.name: analyze_word
tools.description: Morphological analysis of one Ingush word form: lemma, part of speech, grammatical description (case, number, tense, mood…), confidence (high / medium / hypothesis), morpheme segmentation, dictionary gloss and alternative analyses, plus up to 3 corpus examples with translation. Examples: «дегаш» (plural of «дог» 'heart'), «аргдий», «цӀагӀа». If the form is unknown, returns found=false with spelling suggestions — do not invent a form.

tools.name: get_paradigm
tools.description: Inflection table of an Ingush word — noun cases and numbers, verb tenses and moods, adjective forms — as on the word page of paydadosh.ru. `word` is always required: a lemma or any form («дог», «дегаш», «ала»); entry_id from search_dictionary additionally picks the homonym. Every form has a reliability tier: verified (checked by a moderator or native speaker), dictionary (printed in a dictionary), corpus (attested in texts), rule (generated by rules, not attested — may be wrong), auto (filled automatically, unchecked). Rows of verbs (and free adjective forms) carry the class row `cls` {в, й, б, д: form} as on the word card — pick the class of the absolutive; nouns carry `noun_class` with singular and plural class. main_only=true returns only the principal rows.

word.description: Ingush lemma or any of its forms, e.g. «дог», «дегаш», «ала», «кӀант».
word.title: Word

part_of_speech.description: Pick the table type when the word is both, e.g. «ала» (verb 'to say' / noun 'flame').
part_of_speech.title: Part Of Speech

entry_id.description: Optional id of a headword from search_dictionary — picks the right homonym.
entry_id.title: Entry Id

main_only.description: Only the principal rows (verbs: infinitive, masdar, present, past, perfect, future, negatives, imperative, converbs, participles) — a verb table otherwise has 100+ rows.
main_only.title: Main Only

tools.name: find_examples
tools.description: Up to 5 sentences from the PaydaDosh corpus of Ingush texts (books, press, folklore) with Russian translation where available and the source. `translation` tells where the Russian comes from (translation_legend): verified — checked by a moderator or native speaker; published — the printed translation; ai_approved — machine translation accepted by the editors, not checked by a native speaker; draft — machine translation, a draft not checked by a native speaker (never present it as a translation); none. mode='lexical' (default) matches the exact word and its forms (first page only); mode='semantic' searches by meaning across both Ingush and Russian queries (shared limit for all MCP clients). Sentences are short quotations from copyrighted publications — always cite the source. Examples: «дог», «бӀаргаш», «пойти в гости».

word.description: Ingush or Russian word (mode='lexical', default) or a short phrase/idea (mode='semantic'), e.g. «дог», «бӀаргаш», «сердце», «пойти в гости».
word.title: Word

mode.description: lexical (default) — exact word and its forms in the corpus; semantic — meaning-based search across both Ingush and Russian queries.
mode.title: Mode

tools.name: translation_context
tools.description: Everything PaydaDosh knows that is relevant to translating a phrase or answering a question about Ingush — the same material the site's own assistant reads before answering: native-speaker corrections approved by the editors (use them verbatim), ready phrasebook phrases (check the occasion), parallel Ingush–Russian sentences from the corpus (lexical plus meaning-based when lexical hits are sparse), dictionary entries, Ozdoev's Russian–Ingush dictionary with its phraseology, paradigms of the words asked about, grammar notes, examples from reference articles, short story passages (a model of phrasing, not a ready answer), native speakers' answers from the Q&A section «Хаттараш», and ready_answers — a verified ready answer to this very question (use=verbatim — take it as is; use=reference — a participant's answer, check it). Meaning-based corpus pairs are added only with a verified translation (prov). Call it FIRST for any phrase translation (Russian → Ingush or Ingush → Russian), e.g. «Как сказать „я хочу домой“?», «Мел ха яьннай хьа?». Heavier than other tools: limited to 20 calls per minute.

question.description: The user's question or phrase as is, e.g. «Как сказать „я хочу домой“?», «Мел ха яьннай хьа?», «как ты себя чувствуешь».
question.title: Question

tools.name: translate_draft
tools.description: A DRAFT translation between Russian and Ingush by PaydaDosh's neural translator (up to 400 characters and 5 sentences). Every answer has draft=true and draft_note: it is machine output, not checked by a native speaker — never present it as a dictionary fact or a native speaker's translation. Sentences that match an editor's correction of the translator come with verified=true (and alternatives). For Russian → Ingush (`ru2inh`) every Ingush word is checked against PaydaDosh (`word_check`, with card links) and unverified words are flagged. Call translation_context first for idioms and phrases; use translate_draft as a draft aid for whole sentences. Limited: 10 calls per minute per address and a shared daily limit for all MCP clients — when it is used up the answer says so and has no translation. Texts up to 60 characters are kept in our log; longer ones — only their length, direction and unverified words.

text.description: Russian or Ingush sentence or short text to translate (first 400 characters, up to 5 sentences). E.g. «Мы хотим, чтобы наш язык жил.» or «Дог дика да цун.»
text.title: Text

direction.description: ru2inh (Russian → Ingush), inh2ru (Ingush → Russian), or auto (default). Pass ru2inh or inh2ru explicitly when you know the source language.
direction.title: Direction

tools.name: search_terms
tools.description: Batch dictionary lookup: up to 50 Ingush or Russian words in one call (a word list, a glossary, the words of a text). For each word: found, the best headword, part of speech, a short Russian definition, source codes and the word page link; an inflected Ingush form points to its lemma; a miss has suggestions («возможно, имелось в виду»); a word marked skipped=true was not checked in time — retry it. Counts as one call per 5 words in the rate limit (100 words per minute per address). For the full entry of a word use search_dictionary. Our log keeps the first 64 characters of the word list and up to 30 words that were not found.

terms.description: Up to 50 Ingush or Russian words, e.g. [«дог», «кӀант», «сердце»].
terms.title: Terms

direction.description: auto (default) detects the language of each word; ing_to_rus / rus_to_ing for all of them.
direction.title: Direction

tools.name: number_to_words
tools.description: A number in Ingush words with the vigesimal count of the paydadosh.ru/numbers page: cardinal and ordinal (e.g. 44 → шовзткъе диъ, шовзткъе диълагӀа), up to 10^21 − 1 (pass the number as a string of digits); collective numerals and, for 4 and 14, the class forms {в, й, б, д} of collective / distributive numerals from the page's reference table. Words from «диъ» (4), «дийтта» (14), «дезткъа» (80) and numbers built with them start with a class prefix and agree with the noun: the answer gives them in class д only (class_variable, class_note) — forms of other classes are not provided, do not make them up. Use it instead of composing numerals yourself.

number.description: A whole number written with digits only, from 0 to 10^21 − 1, e.g. "44", "1999", "2026".
number.title: Number

noun_class.description: Grammatical class of the counted noun {в, й, б, д}, or any (default). Picks the class forms of the collective / distributive numerals of 4 and 14 from the page's reference table. Words from «диъ» (4), «дийтта» (14), «дезткъа» (80) change by class in every numeral; the answer gives them in class д only and lists them in class_variable.
noun_class.title: Noun Class

tools.name: report_error
tools.description: Send an error report (wrong form, translation, example, class…) to the PaydaDosh editors' moderation queue — the same queue as the error form on a word page. Call it ONLY when the user explicitly asks you to report the error, with their description; otherwise give them the item's report_url. Give word, card_url (the word page) or sentence, the problem and, if known, the correct form. No personal data: do not include names, e-mails or phone numbers (they are removed). Limited: 5 reports per hour per address, 50 per day for all clients. The editors read every report but do not reply through MCP — do not promise a fix.

problem.description: What is wrong, in the user's words (Russian or English), up to 1000 characters.
problem.title: Problem

word.description: The Ingush or Russian word concerned.
word.title: Word

card_url.description: The paydadosh.ru word page (`url` from search_dictionary / get_paradigm), if there is one.
card_url.title: Card Url

sentence.description: The sentence or form concerned, if the error is in an example or a translation.
sentence.title: Sentence

suggestion.description: The correct form or translation, if the user knows it.
suggestion.title: Suggestion

tools.name: check_ingush_text
tools.description: Verify an Ingush text — typically your own draft answer before you send it — with exactly the check the site's own assistant applies to its answers. Every Ingush word gets a verdict: confirmed (found in the dictionary, spelling lexicon, a card's form table, a confident analyzer reading, the corpus, the phrasebook or native speakers' corrections and answers) or unverified (not confirmed anywhere — likely an error or an invented form, with suggestions). Russian words in the text are skipped. Confirmed words come with the analyzer's reading (lemma, part of speech, note), and with a gloss and card link only when the card is unambiguous. Quotes attributed to a source that are not in the data are listed in unverified_quotes. Replace or flag every unverified word instead of presenting it as Ingush. Example: «Сона веза хьо кхоана». Only the unverified words are kept in our log, not the text.

text.description: Ingush text to verify — typically your own draft answer; Russian words in it are recognised and skipped. The first 1000 characters are checked. E.g. «Сона веза хьо кхоана».
text.title: Text

tools.name: check_spelling
tools.description: Spell-check a person's Ingush text (up to 1000 characters) with the PaydaDosh spelling dictionary. Returns each problematic word with its position, kind (error; palochka typed with a wrong letter; rare form; Russian word) and suggestions, class-agreement grammar warnings and, for short phrases, a corrected phrase. Example: «Сона веза хьо гӀулакха». Only the misspelled words are kept in our log, not the text.

text.description: Ingush text; the first 1000 characters are checked. E.g. «Сона веза хьо гӀулакха».
text.title: Text
